# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Plugins — PDF API

> The PDF API lists the methods and events a plugin can use when working with a PDF file in ONLYOFFICE Docs. To work with the PDF content directly, such as pages and annotations, run Office API code in callCommand. See PDF API.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [PDF API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api.md): The PDF API lists the methods and events a plugin can use when working with a PDF file in ONLYOFFICE Docs. To work with the PDF content directly, such as pages and annotations, run Office API code in callCommand. See PDF API.

## Methods

- [CoAuthoringChatSendMessage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/CoAuthoringChatSendMessage.md): Sends a message to the co-authoring chat.
- [EndAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/EndAction.md): Specifies the end action for long operations.
- [FocusEditor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/FocusEditor.md): Returns focus to the editor.
- [GetAllComments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetAllComments.md): Returns all the comments from the document.
- [GetCurrentPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetCurrentPage.md): Returns the current page index.
- [GetFileToDownload](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetFileToDownload.md): Returns the current file to download in the specified format.
- [GetFontList](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetFontList.md): Returns the fonts list.
- [GetInstalledPlugins](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetInstalledPlugins.md): Returns all the installed plugins.
- [GetMacros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetMacros.md): Returns the document macros.
- [GetPageImage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetPageImage.md): Returns the page image.
- [GetRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetRestrictions.md): Returns the restrictions the editor currently applies to the document.
- [GetSelectedText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetSelectedText.md): Returns the selected text from the document.
- [GetVersion](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GetVersion.md): Returns the editor version.
- [GoToPage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/GoToPage.md): Moves to specified page.
- [InstallPlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/InstallPlugin.md): Installs a plugin using the specified plugin config.
- [MouseMoveWindow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/MouseMoveWindow.md): Sends an event to the plugin when the mouse button is moved inside the plugin iframe.
- [MouseUpWindow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/MouseUpWindow.md): Sends an event to the plugin when the mouse button is released inside the plugin iframe.
- [OnDropEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/OnDropEvent.md): Implements the external drag&drop emulation.
- [PasteHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/PasteHtml.md): Pastes text in the HTML format into the document.
- [PasteText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/PasteText.md): Pastes text into the document.
- [RemovePlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/RemovePlugin.md): Removes a plugin with the specified GUID.
- [ReplacePageContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/ReplacePageContent.md): Replaces the page content with the specified parameters.
- [SetMacros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/SetMacros.md): Sets macros to the document.
- [SetPluginsOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/SetPluginsOptions.md): Configures plugins from an external source.
- [SetProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/SetProperties.md): Sets the properties to the document.
- [ShowButton](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/ShowButton.md): Shows or hides buttons in the header.
- [ShowError](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/ShowError.md): Shows an error/warning message.
- [ShowInputHelper](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/ShowInputHelper.md): Shows the input helper.
- [StartAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/StartAction.md): Specifies the start action for long operations.
- [UnShowInputHelper](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/UnShowInputHelper.md): Unshows the input helper.
- [UpdatePlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Methods/UpdatePlugin.md): Updates a plugin using the specified plugin config.

## Events

- [onChangeRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onChangeRestrictions.md): The function called when the restrictions in the editor are changed.
- [onClick](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onClick.md): The function called when the user clicks the element.
- [onDocumentContentReady](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onDocumentContentReady.md): The function called when the document is completely loaded.
- [onEnableMouseEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onEnableMouseEvent.md): The function called to turn the mouse or touchpad events on/off.
- [onExternalMouseUp](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onExternalMouseUp.md): The function called when the mouse button is released outside the plugin iframe.
- [onFloatActionButtonClick](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onFloatActionButtonClick.md): The function called when the floating action button has been clicked.
- [onSelectionCancel](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onSelectionCancel.md): The function called was when selection was canceled.
- [onSelectionEnd](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onSelectionEnd.md): The function called to when selection was ended.
- [onTargetPositionChanged](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Events/onTargetPositionChanged.md): The function called when the target position in the editor is changed.

## Enumeration

- [CommentData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/CommentData.md): The comment data.
- [EditorRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/EditorRestrictions.md): The current editing restrictions, a combination of the flags: 0x00 - no editing restrictions, 0x01 - allows editing form fields, 0x02 - allows editing comments and regions delimited by range permissions, 0x04 - the document is signed and cannot be changed, 0x80 - does not allow editing.
- [Event_pt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/Event_pt.md): A point.
- [FontInfo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/FontInfo.md): An object containing the font information.
- [Macros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/Macros.md): An object containing the data about all the macros from the document.
- [PluginData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/PluginData.md): The plugin object.
- [PluginOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/PluginOptions.md): The plugin options.
- [Rect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/Rect.md): Axis-aligned rectangle represented as a tuple.
- [ReplaceHtmlOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/ReplaceHtmlOptions.md): Options to replace the HTML page content.
- [ReplaceXmlOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/ReplaceXmlOptions.md): Options to replace the XML page content.
- [ShapeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/ShapeType.md): This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.
- [comment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/comment.md): Comment object.
- [fillForms](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/fillForms.md): An object containing the form properties.
- [pt](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/pt.md): A point.
- [watermark_on_draw](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/pdf-api/Enumeration/watermark_on_draw.md): An object containing the watermark properties.
